section: Our own code is switched on
roadmap: Our own replacements are the default (platform, renderers, WAV, fonts, code editor, OkayUI screens), OKAY_THIRD_PARTY=1 goes back, automatic fallback to SDL
---
- New on Windows, so it may have bugs there: the launcher, the editor and
  games now run on our own code wherever we
  have written a replacement, so you can test it: our own window, keyboard,
  mouse and sound layer (instead of SDL), our own drawing for the launcher
  and the editor, our own font drawing (sharper text), our own code box in
  the Script Editor, and our own UI (OkayUI) for the pages that have been
  rebuilt: in the launcher What's New, Tips, Downloads, Achievements,
  Notifications, Friends and Community; in the editor Console, Crash Log, Audio Mixer, Problems,
  Stats, History, Profiler, Import settings, Post-processing and Project
  Settings. Passwords and encryption still use libsodium, as before.
- How to tell: the launcher writes one line to okay_launcher.log (next to
  OkaySpace.exe), and the editor shows it in its Console, for example
  "own: platform, renderer, wav, fonts, code editor, okayui screens;
  third party: libsodium".
- If our own window or drawing cannot start on your PC, the program says
  so in that log or Console and starts the old way by itself.
- How to go back: open a Command Prompt, type  set OKAY_THIRD_PARTY=1
  and start OkaySpace.exe from that window. Everything then runs on the
  old code. To go back for one part only: OKAY_PLATFORM_BACKEND=sdl2,
  OKAY_LAUNCHER_RENDERER=sdl, OKAY_EDITOR_PLATFORM=sdl,
  OKAY_EDITOR_RENDERER=sdl, OKAY_OWN_WAV=0, OKAY_OWN_FONT_RASTER=0,
  OKAY_CODE_EDITOR=imgui or OKAY_UI_BACKEND=imgui.
- This was built and tried on Linux only. It has never run on Windows, so
  please tell us what looks or works differently, and whether it still
  happens with OKAY_THIRD_PARTY=1. Steps: docs/try_it.md, section 0b.
- The launcher's background work (downloads, news, chat, updates) uses our
  own threads. The Downloads rows show their buttons in full, and a click
  right after moving onto a page or chip works the first time.
